body.title: Extend the catalog contract test with the enrichment-completeness guards
body.summary: In src/config/__tests__/config-catalog-contract.test.ts add assertions that every CONFIG_CATALOG row has a non-empty string group and every type:'enum' row has a non-empty enumValues (and non-enum rows omit it), leaving the existing length===31, single-definition-site, FROM_CLI===FROM_CONFIG, and RETIRED_PATHS-disjointness assertions intact.
acceptanceChecks: The contract suite passes and now fails if any row lacks a group or any enum row lacks enumValues.
The pre-existing assertions (length 31, single site, re-export identity, RETIRED_PATHS 6 disjoint) remain and still pass.

tests.name: config-catalog-contract: the new group + enumValues completeness assertions
config-catalog-contract: pre-existing invariants (length 31, single site, FROM_CLI===FROM_CONFIG, RETIRED_PATHS 6 disjoint) still pass
